title: Mode-2 Anchor Generation Response
description: Sprint Φ-D-MODE2 Completion — strict JSON schema for LLM-generated anchor proposals. Any LLM response that fails this schema triggers a retry, then a fallback to Mode-1. Cf. docs/EFE_MODE2_ANCHORS_COMPLETION_ARCHITECTURE.md § 10.2.

anchors.description: One anchor entry per catalog label.

label_id.description: Must match an existing label id in the catalog.

examples.description: Representative example texts that exemplify this label.

reasoning.description: Optional LLM-provided reasoning (= debugging only, not used for vector computation).

metadata.description: Optional metadata block ; ignored by anchor materialization.
